objective: Create a strict local fixture-bundle contract and deterministic train/holdout splitter.
implementation: Added versioned FixtureBundle and VerifiedFixture contracts.
Required HTTP(S) source URL, SHA-256 fingerprint, timezone-aware retrieval timestamp, verifier, and notes.
Added fail-closed bundle loading and deterministic seeded ID splitting.
SEALED_READY is required before a fixture can participate in the sealed holdout.
boundaries: No source documents were fabricated or treated as verified.
Parsing a bundle does not establish that its source evidence is real.
No network or live execution was added.
